test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Training your dog **__have required a lot__** of patience.
solution:
The correct answer is **"requires a lot."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Subject-Verb agreement, the singular subject takes a singular verb and the plural subject takes a plural verb.
 
• The verb** 'training' **requires a singular subject, which is **'your dog'.**
 
• The present tense form of the verb **'require' **that matches with the singular subject **'your dog'** is** 'requires'.**
 
• So, the correct answer is** option 2.**

 

**Correct sentence:** *Training your dog **requires a lot**__ of patience.*
